goal: Get a group of friends from 'we should go skiing' to a booked trip: everyone marks when they're free, the board shows the overlap, and someone turns it into a trip the group agrees on.
success: A real group plans at least one 2026-27 ski trip through it: rows filled, a suggestion made from a snow window, and accepted by the group.

milestones.title: Trip suggestions with accept / tentative / decline

tasks.title: Build the availability timeline with rows, emoji, holidays and snow windows
tasks.why: The core of the idea.
tasks.doneWhen: Board works in demo mode; migration tested on PGlite (2026-11-25).

tasks.title: Register snow_window in the Supabase sandbox (APP.md: anonymous sign-in allowed, join_mode open) and push the migration
tasks.why: Spec: docs/spec/auth-and-crews.md. Live 2026-11-25: migration 20261125160000 applied (5 tables with RLS, 22 functions, app open + anonymous), schema app_snow_window exposed, redirect URLs added. The config push also reset six shared auth/storage settings to local-dev values; Juho restored them the same day (verified by config diff). Left: merge supabase-sandbox branch app/snow-window (APP.md + sandbox t12) into main and push.
tasks.doneWhen: supabase-sandbox main has apps/snow_window/APP.md.

tasks.title: Create the GitHub repo, set Pages + secrets, deploy
tasks.why: Public URL to share with the group.
tasks.doneWhen: https://juholyde.github.io/snow-window/ loads the shared board.

tasks.title: Clarify trip suggestions: fields, day trip vs multi-day, accommodation, who decides
tasks.why: Section 2 of the idea; Juho wanted to look at it after the board.
tasks.doneWhen: Answered 2026-11-25: stay = link + price per night + note; dates = any stretch, showing who is free; outcome = tally, proposer marks it On; responders = anyone with a row, as that row. Built as t10.

tasks.title: Decide: what stops a stranger from vandalising rows (only 20 places, no sign-in)
tasks.why: Anyone with the link can fill all 20 places; tokens protect existing rows but not the slots.
tasks.doneWhen: Answered 2026-11-25 by sign-in plus crews: every visitor is an (anonymous) account, a crew is only reachable by its invite link, the owner can remove members and reset the link.

tasks.title: Snow palette with orange accent, display face, flat layered hero
tasks.why: Juho asked for a UI that looks really cool: snow palette, orange as the contrasting highlight, no gradient slop.
tasks.doneWhen: OKLCH tokens in style.css, Big Shoulders Display, SVG icon set, impeccable detector clean (2026-11-25).

tasks.title: Resort weather row: Open-Meteo forecast for days within 16 days
tasks.why: Juho: poll weather for days that can be reached.
tasks.doneWhen: Forecast row with resort picker, fresh snow >= 5 cm in orange, all resorts in the day card, 30-min cache and poll (2026-11-25).

tasks.title: Place the remaining Codex art (sun, tycoon skier) in the app
tasks.why: Codex's set is in public/art (85c628b). Panorama, wordmark, favicon in use; Rufus is back in the crew-of-one invite band (3114690). Sun and tycoon skier not placed yet. Raw drafts stay untracked in generated_images/.
tasks.doneWhen: All Codex art placed (2026-11-25): panorama, wordmark, favicon, Rufus in the crew-of-one invite band, the sun in the masthead sky (hidden on phones), the tycoon skier in the empty Answer view. Raw drafts stay untracked in generated_images/.

tasks.title: One-screen app with tabs (Board, Snow windows, Resorts) and resort webcams
tasks.why: Juho: keep everything on one page without scrolling; add a tab for the resorts with webcams.
tasks.doneWhen: 100dvh shell, sticky timeline header/crew/forecast rows, side panel; Resorts tab with 7-day forecast and official webcam links checked 2026-11-25.

tasks.title: Trips tab: suggest a day trip or stay, group answers Going/Maybe/Can't, proposer marks it on
tasks.why: Section 2 of the idea: turn snow windows into concrete trip suggestions.
tasks.doneWhen: Migration with suggestions + responses and RPCs (max 40 trips, 14 days, https stay links), composer with date picks and coverage, trip cards with stay cost and tally, verified desktop + mobile (2026-11-25).

tasks.title: Trips split into Suggest (pick dates on the timeline) and Answer (cards with big answer buttons)
tasks.why: Juho: separate suggesting from accepting; a timeline for suggesting; the first Trips UI was hard to use.
tasks.doneWhen: Timeline pick mode (tap first and last day, mouse drag), TripForm beside it, Answer view with resort photos; verified desktop + mobile (2026-11-25).

tasks.title: Resort photos (Wikimedia Commons, credited) and travel from Barcelona by car, bus, train
tasks.why: Juho: show the resorts, and how far and how to get there.
tasks.doneWhen: 7 photos in public/resorts with author + licence; travel times in resorts.ts, approximate (Rome2rio, 2026-11-25).

tasks.title: Check Barcelona travel times against official winter 2026-27 timetables (Alsa, Avanza, Sagalés, Rodalies R3)
tasks.why: Current figures come from Rome2rio; alsa.com and baqueira.es refuse automated fetches, so a person checks them in a browser.
tasks.doneWhen: Each bus/train leg in resorts.ts matches a published 2026-27 timetable, or is marked seasonal.

tasks.title: Crews and guest-first sign-in: create a crew, invite link, many crews per person, one calendar per person
tasks.why: Juho asked 2026-11-25 for an auth path and named crews collecting people, joined by invite link.
tasks.doneWhen: Migration + 6 PGlite tests, CrewStore (Local + Supabase), welcome/join card, crew panel, crew switcher, account dialog; verified in the browser on LocalStore; commit 85c628b (2026-11-25).

tasks.title: Save and sign in with Google (Juho chose yes 2026-11-25; needs enable_manual_linking in the sandbox)
tasks.why: Email-only save works today; Google linking is a project-wide Supabase auth setting that affects every sandbox app.
tasks.doneWhen: A guest on the live site saves with Google and keeps their crews; sandbox config has enable_manual_linking = true.
tasks.note: 2026-11-26: live (b317a5f), sandbox manual linking pushed + merged (c77a22e). Juho's Save with Google returned identity_already_exists (his Google is already a sandbox user), which proves linking is on. Not yet seen: a Google account new to the sandbox linking to a guest and keeping crews; check the first time a friend saves.

tasks.title: Full-width timeline: crew sheet from the header, day strip under the board, trip form under the Suggest timeline
tasks.why: Juho 2026-11-25: the timeline needs the full width.
tasks.doneWhen: Commit 3114690; checked desktop and phone.

tasks.title: Stays after agreement + calmer controls (Juho 2026-11-26): stay options with an AI prompt and paste-back once a trip is on; no native selects or date pickers
tasks.why: The suggest form asked for a place before anyone agreed on dates; native dropdowns and date pickers clashed with the app.
tasks.doneWhen: Migration 20261126120000 live in the sandbox, app pushed, a stay pasted on the live site.
tasks.note: 2026-11-26: migration 20261126120000 live (tables, gates, 6 functions checked; API sees them), app a40c90f deployed. Left: one real trip marked on with a pasted stay on the live site. 2026-11-27: full flow checked in demo mode with mock places (suggest, mark on, budget/driving, copy prompt, bad paste error, paste 3 STAY lines, vote, book, reopen keeps data, mobile 375px). Found and fixed: numbered '3. STAY' lines were dropped and trailing '**' kept. Left: Juho's own live try.

tasks.title: Nudge people about trips waiting on their answer
tasks.why: Nothing tells a friend a trip was suggested; TripCard only flags unanswered inside the Trips tab and the 30s poll is silent.
tasks.doneWhen: Trips tab badge counts trips where my row is unanswered, a Board banner links to them, both clear once I answer; unit test on the count.
tasks.result: Trips tab badge now counts open/on trips I have not answered (awaitingAnswer in trips.ts, tested); Board banner with Answer button opens Trips > Answer; both clear on answering.

tasks.title: Copy a WhatsApp-ready trip summary and invite message
tasks.why: The crew lives in WhatsApp; an on trip has no copyable text and the invite is a bare link.
tasks.doneWhen: Copy summary on an on trip gives dates, resort, who is going, the booked stay and the crew link; Copy invite link adds a short message with the crew name; pure formatter with unit tests.
tasks.result: src/lib/share.ts tripSummary + inviteMessage (tests/share.test.ts); Copy summary button on on-trip cards, Copy invite link now copies message + link.

tasks.title: Add a next-step strip that guides the crew through the journey
tasks.why: After joining, people land on a bare board with no hint to mark days, then suggest a trip from the overlap.
tasks.doneWhen: One strip derives the step from crew state (few marked, no window, no trip, awaiting answers) with one button to the right tab, hidden once a trip is on; unit test on the step logic.
tasks.result: nextStep() in lib/nextStep.ts (tested) drives one Board strip (replaces the t18 banner): answer, mark days, nudge to invite, suggest a trip, see windows; hidden once a trip is on.

tasks.title: Show clear errors for expired sessions and the anonymous sign-in limit
tasks.why: call() throws raw Supabase messages, and the sandbox allows 30 anonymous sign-ins per hour per IP, so a group on one wifi can hit it with no explanation.
tasks.doneWhen: Not-signed-in and rate-limit errors show a plain sign-in-again / try-later message; store test with a mocked client covers both.
tasks.result: explain() in supabaseStore maps 429/over_request_rate_limit to guest_limit and 401/PGRST301/bad_jwt/session_not_found to not_signed_in; the 30s poll toasts a repeated error once; tests/supabaseStore.test.ts.

tasks.title: Add to calendar (.ics) for trips that are on
tasks.why: A decided trip should land in everyone's phone calendar; needs no server.
tasks.doneWhen: An on trip offers a download of a valid all-day .ics with resort, plan and stay link; unit test covers the exclusive end date; opens in Apple Calendar.

tasks.title: Show a countdown and powder watch for the next on trip
tasks.why: Open-Meteo already feeds the board; days-to-go plus forecast snow on the trip days gives people a reason to open the app between plans.
tasks.doneWhen: Board and Trips show days to go for the nearest on trip and, within the 16-day forecast, snowfall per trip day with 5 cm+ days highlighted; hidden with no forecast days.

tasks.title: Test the app flows as components against LocalStore
tasks.why: Only logic and migration tests exist; App.vue holds the poll, invite and act() flows untested.
tasks.doneWhen: Vitest with happy-dom covers mark days, join by invite, answer a trip and book a stay against LocalStore; full suite passes.

tasks.title: Walk the invite-to-answer journey on a phone with a full 20-person crew
tasks.why: Success needs a real group on phones; drag-to-mark, range picks and 20 rows of 24-character names were never tried together at 390px.
tasks.doneWhen: Playwright on a local seeded demo at 390px: a fresh guest joins by link, marks days, suggests and answers; a 20-member long-name crew renders without overflow; screenshots kept and friction filed as tasks.

tasks.title: Celebrate when everyone says Going
tasks.why: The moment a trip locks in is the high point, and Rufus's art is unused there.
tasks.doneWhen: When the tally turns all Going the card shows a one-time Rufus banner with snowfall, respecting prefers-reduced-motion; test covers the trigger.

tasks.title: Share a trip card image to the group chat
tasks.why: A branded card with resort photo, dates and who is going spreads the app and rewards the planner.
tasks.doneWhen: Share renders a 1080x1350 PNG client-side and uses the Web Share API with a download fallback.

tasks.title: Decide how people hear about changes
tasks.why: Updates are poll-only and last-write-wins; options are email via Supabase, web push, Realtime, or a copy-a-nudge to non-responders.
tasks.doneWhen: Juho picks an option and a follow-up labour task is filed.

tasks.title: Audit keyboard and screen-reader use of the timeline and trip flow
tasks.why: Timeline day cells are click handlers with few aria attributes; nothing was tried by keyboard or VoiceOver.
tasks.doneWhen: Keyboard-only and VoiceOver passes over mark, overlap, answer and stay vote; each failure filed as a task.

tasks.title: Decide on car-share and packing lists
tasks.why: Barcelona crews drive up; seats and who-brings-what need new tables, so confirm it is wanted first.
tasks.doneWhen: Juho chooses car seats, packing list, both or neither; a follow-up task with a migration outline is filed if any.
